meta.title: typocasual
meta.tagline: a structure, left out in the weather
meta.blurb: A contact sheet. Every frame printed at the same size, nothing ranked.

items.title: Statement
items.body: Concrete was an argument about permanence. Moss is a shorter argument, and it is winning.
items.note: Read the sheet left to right. The structure gives way as you go.

items.title: South Elevation
items.subject: Raking light on the exposed face
items.note: One hour before the shadow line reached the third floor.

items.title: Epilogue
items.note: Carries the wordmark. The only face here set heavy enough to hold a wall up.

items.title: Colonnade
items.subject: Eleven bays, receding
items.note: Counted twice on site. Eleven, not twelve.

items.title: Method
items.body: Every frame is the same size. The sheet does not rank the work — it lays it out, and lets the weather in.
items.note: Nothing on this page is cropped to flatter.

items.title: Aperture Study
items.subject: Light entering at a single point
items.note: The brightest thing in the series, and the smallest.

items.title: Lora
items.note: Set against the concrete so the structure has a voice that is not shouting.

items.title: Service Tunnel
items.subject: Zero daylight
items.note: The only frame on the sheet with no growth in it.

items.title: Stair Core
items.subject: Water ingress, north wall
items.note: Mapped over four winters. The stain is the only thing here still changing shape.

items.title: Materials
items.body: Board-marked concrete, galvanised steel, standing water. Then grass, moss, and eleven species nobody specified.
items.note: The planting was never designed. It arrived.

items.title: Gutter Detail
items.subject: Where it starts
items.note: A joint that failed is a joint that became a bed.

items.title: Atkinson Hyperlegible
items.note: Drawn for legibility, which is the opposite of what a typo is. Kept anyway.

items.title: North Wall
items.subject: The shaded face
items.note: Green on every surface that never dries out.

items.title: Loading Bay
items.subject: The only elevation fully taken
items.note: Grasses in the gutter joints. Structurally irrelevant, visually total.

items.title: Foundation
items.subject: At the waterline
items.note: The heaviest part of the building, and the wettest.

items.title: Colophon
items.body: Set in system faces. Printed on a Cloudflare Worker. Growing at roughly a millimetre a year, which is faster than the concrete is aging.
items.note: The red line under the title is the only part of this that is working exactly as intended.

items.title: Roofline
items.subject: Colonisation from above
items.note: The sky is doing most of the structural work in this one.

items.title: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono
items.note: Frame numbers, captions, and everything the grid needed to say.

items.title: Parapet
items.subject: The edge, giving up
items.note: Last frame before the sheet stops being readable as architecture.

items.title: Podium
items.subject: Fully returned
items.note: You would not know there was a building here.
